title: −30°C, no shoes… why did 9 hikers walk away?
subtitle: Dead Mountain · Short 2/6 · Yayında
caption:
Most of the Dyatlov group were dressed for sleep. Some wore only socks. Yet their footprints show no panic – they walked downhill together for more than a kilometre and a half toward the forest.
